about: Held-out set for the inference judge (src/inference-judge.ts, #302): inferences on real recorded turns, each case's originals (which the answer backs) paired with mutations the word rules in assertions.ts pass but the judge must catch. A case stands in the place of its trace's assertion at index, resting on the accepted assertions in supports; the judge also reads the answer's other accepted observations and comparisons (rest_of_answer) and every figure its tables and charts show (figures_shown). Each kind must come back at its expected outcome (scripts/answer-lab.ts MUTATION_TIERS): an original entailed, with worded_amount false; worded_amount with the worded_amount flag true, at any verdict, which hides it; unsupported_claim and hedged_valuation unsupported, flag false, shown labelled as an unverified analyst view; flipped_direction and contradicted_ranking contradicted, flag false, which hides it. A worded_amount, flipped_direction or contradicted_ranking mutation that comes back shown or unverified counts as shown though it should hide. source: trace (the trace's own accepted inference), edited (the trace's inference with a worded quantity cut), adapted (an inference the trace's checks rejected for naming companies, rewritten about its subject), written (a new inference on the trace's accepted supports, where the trace's own claims more than they show), narrowed (the trace's inference, rewritten to claim only what the whole answer shows, whose supports leave out figures it rests on that another accepted observation shows, so only rest_of_answer backs it; its mutation contradicts a figure shown only there), block (an inference resting on figures that neither its supports nor the rest of the answer state and only a fact block shows, so only figures_shown backs it; its mutation contradicts a figure shown only in that block). Some worded_amount mutations also make an unsupported claim (a forecast or cause with an amount in words), and two state a span the page bears out (the fiscal-year offsets), so only the flag hides them. Naming a company by ticker, name or alias is no fault in itself (owner, 2026-10-18), so an original may name one when the answer backs what it says; a hedged valuation or market reading the answer does not show is a mutation. The narrowed and block cases, the mixed and right worded_amount mutations, and the two unsupported_claim rewordings in commit 7b31dbf were written in this PR (#477) beside the prompt change, so the set is no longer held out from this prompt. Run: node --experimental-strip-types scripts/answer-lab.ts judge-mutations test/answer-lab/judge-mutations.json
